headline: Fresh Base Battles Flare in Callahan's Passage as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Callahan's Passage has broken into renewed movement, recording fresh strategic base transitions alongside a sharp casualty spike exceeding eighteen hundred combined losses over the past two hours. Weathered Expanse remains locked in unrelenting combat, adding six strategic base exchanges in the last two hours across Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Wightwalk as casualty rates continue to climb on both sides. In Mooring County, heavy attrition persists with nearly nine hundred combined casualties in the two-hour window, though base handovers around The Wind Hills have paused. Meanwhile, several maritime sectors have cooled considerably; Stlican Shelf recorded no further base changes following earlier clashes at Breaker Town, and Fisherman's Row has seen combat drop to a near standstill. Nevish Line continues to sustain localized exchanges near Grief Mother, but wider territorial lines remain steady across the quieted sectors.
